subject: One empty wide shallow tabletop tray, seen nearly overhead. Match the projected silhouette, angle and proportions of reference 2. Use reference 1 alone for the rendering style. The entire back rim is visible, the two back corners taper slightly inward, and the low near lip casts a narrow contact shadow. Light from upper left. The central bed is a single uninterrupted resting surface for the runtime foreground. Show the complete tray alone on transparent ground with space around all four edges. No cards, dice, pips, letters, numbers, coins, people, emblems, captions, buttons, or artwork outside the silhouette. A folded warm-paper tray with restrained black rules along its lip and one small spot of printed colour on the edge. Keep the central bed plain and the black rules below the cards. Limit any red to a tiny edge accent.
